ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: I picked Plover because this query is a straightforward, well-defined quantitative problem (compute an expected value, round to two decimals), and Plover has the stronger measured capability profile across the board — higher reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2, GPQA 64.1) and a higher Extraction & Retrieval eval (85.3 vs 79.2). Neither model's self-reported task preferences are relevant or distinguishing for a benign math question like this, and those preferences are documented as dissociated from output quality anyway. So I defaulted to the model with the better capability numbers.
